text_block_list.text: I did it... I ran properly... Hehehe...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Thank you! Trainer, you know... I'm
finally feeling
a little more confident!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
She's true to her word. This is a huge
leap in terms
of growth. Not to
mention...
choice_data_list:
(Her running has certainly gotten better
too—that's for sure.)

text_block_list.text:
She stands her ground, even in a
high-pace senior
graded race. If she
keeps this up...

Do you think I can do it now?! Run with
Opera O
in a senior G1?
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
You can't go running with Opera O just
yet. There
still stands one opponent you
must defeat!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Heaven calls upon me, Buddha as my
witness.
Spirits begone, vanquished by
the spinach leaf!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text: You want to run with Opera O? Then do so after defeating me, Matikanefukukitaru!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Huh, Fukukitaru? But I thought we were
kindred
spirits...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Why yes, we are. However... I assure you
my
challenge comes with a profound and
esoteric
meaning.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
I get the feeling Матиканэфукукитару is
planning
something, I can't be
completely sure though.

Then, that settles it! This challenge will
take place
nowhere other than...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen at the end of the year!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару
choice_data_list: Isn't that a little far away?

text_block_list.text: Then, how about the Kinko Sho?
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
A swift and easy response. With that, it's

decided—the friends will face off in the
Kinko Sho
this March.
